Inglenook Night colors for the Mod Organizer 2 mod list and plugin list.

Open Settings, then the Theme tab. Under Colors, double-click a row, type its
value into the HTML box, set Alpha channel to 255, and click OK.

Is overwritten (loose files)            #333a2e
Is overwriting (loose files)            #412f2c
Is overwritten (archives)               #28322b
Is overwriting (archives)               #3a2a2a
Mod contains selected file              #31383e
Plugin is contained in selected mod     #31383e
Plugin is master of selected plugin     #2c3a38
